content: Pix/payment webhook best practice: treat delivery as at-least-once (duplicates expected); dedupe on unique event id (e.g., Pix EndToEndId or gateway event id) stored with a unique DB constraint before processing; verify webhook signature before trusting payload; handler should verify -> persist/enqueue -> ACK 2xx quickly, do heavy work async; never trust client-side 'payment done' callback as source of truth.
